tasks.title: Run migration MS-001 — Create cars table
tasks.description: Execute the up script for MS-001 to create the cars table in PostgreSQL. Verify the table exists and the down script (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cars) rolls back cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: cars table exists in the database after running the up script
cars table has columns: id, name, type, availability_status
Running the down script drops the cars table cleanly
Migration is idempotent — running up twice does not error

tasks.title: Run migration MS-002 — Create bookings table
tasks.description: Execute the up script for MS-002 to create the bookings table with BYTEA columns for encrypted PII (email, name). Verify FK to cars and down script rollback.
acceptance_criteria: bookings table exists after running the up script
email and name columns are of type BYTEA
car_id foreign key references cars(id)
Running the down script drops the bookings table cleanly
Migration is idempotent — running up twice does not error

tasks.title: Run migration MS-003 — Create deletion_requests table
tasks.description: Execute the up script for MS-003 to create the deletion_requests table for GDPR erasure tracking. Verify the down script rolls back cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: deletion_requests table exists after running the up script
Table has columns: id, email_hash, requested_at, completed_at
email_hash is VARCHAR(64) — non-reversible SHA-256 hash
Running the down script drops the deletion_requests table cleanly
Migration is idempotent — running up twice does not error

tasks.title: Implement GET /api/cars endpoint
tasks.description: Build the Express route GET /api/cars. Query the cars table with pagination (page, limit). Return cars array, total count, and current page. Validate query params with zod.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/cars returns a list of cars with name, type, availability_status
Response includes total count and current page
Pagination works correctly with page and limit query params
Response time is under 3 seconds
Invalid query params return a 400 error with a clear message
Error handling is implemented — DB errors return 500 with no stack trace exposed

tasks.title: Build car listing UI page
tasks.description: Implement the Next.js car listing page. Fetch from GET /api/cars. Display each car with name, type, and availability. Show a loading skeleton while fetching. Handle empty state.
acceptance_criteria: Car list is displayed on the main screen
Each car shows name, type, and availability status
Loading skeleton is shown while API call is in flight
Empty state is shown if no cars are returned
Page loads and renders within 3 seconds
No console errors on load

tasks.title: Implement POST /api/bookings/validate-dates endpoint
tasks.description: Build the Express route POST /api/bookings/validate-dates. Validate that start_date is not in the past and end_date is not before start_date. Return valid boolean and error message.
acceptance_criteria: Returns { valid: true } for a valid date range
Returns { valid: false, error: '...' } if end_date is before start_date
Returns { valid: false, error: '...' } if start_date is in the past
Invalid or missing date fields return a 400 error
Error handling is implemented — unexpected errors return 500 with no stack trace exposed

tasks.notes: Bypassed server-side date conflict check for MVP launch
tasks.title: Build date picker component with client-side validation
tasks.description: Implement the date picker UI component for start and end date selection. Enforce client-side rules: no past start dates, no end before start. Show inline error within 300ms of invalid input.
acceptance_criteria: Date picker is shown for both start and end date
Past dates are disabled in the start date picker
End date picker disables dates before the selected start date
Selecting an invalid range shows an inline error within 300ms
No console errors during interaction

tasks.title: Implement AWS KMS encryption helper for PII fields
tasks.description: Build a reusable encryption/decryption helper using @aws-sdk/client-kms. Encrypt email and name using AES-256 via KMS before writing to DB. Keys must never be logged or stored with data.
acceptance_criteria: encrypt(value) returns a BYTEA-compatible encrypted buffer
decrypt(buffer) returns the original plaintext
Encryption key is loaded from AWS KMS — not from env or codebase
No plaintext PII is logged at any point during encrypt/decrypt
Unit tests cover encrypt and decrypt round-trip

tasks.title: Implement POST /api/bookings endpoint
tasks.description: Build the Express route POST /api/bookings. Validate inputs with zod. Encrypt email and name using the KMS helper before inserting into the bookings table. Return booking_id and confirmed_at.
acceptance_criteria: Valid request creates a booking record and returns booking_id and confirmed_at
email and name are encrypted before being written to the database
Missing required fields return a 400 error with field-level error messages
Invalid car_id returns a 404 error
Server-side date validation is enforced before persisting
Error handling is implemented — DB errors return 500 with no stack trace exposed

tasks.title: Build booking form with submission and confirmation UI
tasks.description: Implement the booking form page in Next.js. Integrate car selection, date picker, email and name inputs. Submit to POST /api/bookings. Show confirmation message within 1 second of success. Disable submit until all fields are filled.
acceptance_criteria: Booking form displays car selector, date picker, email, and name fields
Submit button is disabled until all required fields are filled
Successful submission shows a confirmation message within 1 second
Field-level error messages are shown for any missing or invalid fields
No console errors during submission flow

tasks.title: Implement Data Deletion Service logic
tasks.description: Build the GDPR erasure service. Given a user email, find and permanently delete all matching bookings rows. Insert a deletion_requests record with SHA-256 email hash and completed_at. Do not log PII.
acceptance_criteria: All bookings rows matching the user email are permanently deleted
A deletion_requests record is created with SHA-256 email hash and completed_at timestamp
No plaintext PII is written to logs during the deletion process
Deleted data cannot be recovered after deletion
Unit tests cover the full deletion flow

tasks.title: Implement DELETE /api/users/data endpoint
tasks.description: Build the Express route DELETE /api/users/data. Accept email in request body. Invoke the Data Deletion Service. Return deleted: true and confirmed_at on success. Enforce TLS.
acceptance_criteria: Valid request triggers permanent deletion of all PII for the given email
Response returns { deleted: true, confirmed_at: ISO8601 }
Missing or invalid email returns a 400 error
Endpoint is accessible and responds within 24 hours SLA
No PII is logged during the request lifecycle
Error handling is implemented — unexpected errors return 500 with no stack trace exposed

tasks.title: Build GDPR data deletion request UI
tasks.description: Implement a simple GDPR deletion request page in Next.js. User enters their email and submits. Calls DELETE /api/users/data. Shows confirmation that deletion has been initiated.
acceptance_criteria: Page displays an email input and a submit button
Submitting a valid email calls DELETE /api/users/data
Success state shows confirmation that deletion has been initiated
Invalid or missing email shows a field-level error message
No console errors during submission flow
